title: 青岚风云 第3章 四系伪灵根破格录为内门弟子青岚风云 第4章 初上青岚宗越级打败炼气六层
slug: 凡人修仙我能无限重生
content_zh:
青阳城，中央广场！
人山人海，汇集了青阳城各大家族子弟，他们都是冲着青岚宗选拔而来的。
青岚宗，是远近闻名的修仙大派，要是能拜入宗门，便能一步登天，彻底脱离小城桎梏！
此刻，林家族老们早已换了一副嘴脸，尽都笑嘻嘻地围着林越，嘴里全是巴结讨好之辞。
“林越贤侄，今日选拔定能拔得头筹，林家以后全靠你了！”
就连族长林远辞也亲自奉上了一块上品灵石。
林越扫了一眼他手中的灵石，并没有接下，只冷冷道：“分内之事。”
林远辞讪讪地收回手，脸上挤出尴尬的笑，心底虽有怒气却不敢表现出来。毕竟林越已是炼气五层，还是李长老看中的人才，再也不是往日人人唾弃，随意拿捏的废物了。
在不远处，几道身影挤进人群，是林浩的父亲林坤，还有被抬在担架上，废了一只胳膊的林浩。两父子怨毒至极的看着我，却不敢靠前半步。
“青岚宗选拔，规矩不变！先测灵根资质，再测灵力境界，最后自愿切磋，优中选优，合格者入外门，拔尖者可争内门名额！”
这时，端坐高台的李长老说话了，他话音刚落，便有几名子弟迫不及待地冲上去测试灵根。
“王家公子王腾，三系杂灵根，炼气四层！”
“苏家旁系苏明，两系灵根，炼气三层！”
……
场下一片叫好，李长老摸着胡须，点头称赞。
很快便轮到了林越，他刚走出人群，场下便哄然大笑起来。人群中有不少人指着他讥笑不止。
“快看，林家那个废物也来了，四系伪灵根，好意思来丢人现眼！”
“林家真是没落了，派这么个废物来参加选拔，简直是浪费名额！”
“我听说，他已经是炼气五层了，我看这都是他们吹牛，伪灵根怎么可能修炼的这么快！”
“林越！你个伪灵根的废物，修炼快又怎么样？灵根不行就别想着出头，赶紧滚下来，别耽误大家时间！我还急着回家吃泡面呢！”

林越充耳不闻，将手掌按在测灵玉上。
四道暗淡的微光亮起，正是四系伪灵根。
轰——
全场再次爆发出刺耳的哄笑。
“哈哈哈！果然是伪灵根！”
“我就说嘛，境界再高也是废物，灵根是天生的，改不了！”
林坤露出一丝冷笑，四系伪灵根，连给青岚宗打杂的资格都没有，李长老除非是抽了疯，否则决不会选这么个废物。
谁知此时，李长老却突然站起身，快步走到测灵玉前，盯着那四道灵光，不可置信道：
“没错，是四系伪灵根不假，但你这灵根虽然驳杂，但灵气运转极稳，且隐隐有提纯之兆，是常年以精纯灵力滋养之故！寻常修士根本做不到，你这是……””
“勤能补拙。只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针！”林越故意隐瞒了昨晚刷妖丹的事，他在黑风岭重生了三次，炼化了几十颗一级黑风狼妖丹，体内的灵力当然比寻常之人精纯数倍。
嘿嘿，林越暗暗好笑，重生能继承前世灵力，这简直是漏洞般的存在。
“好一个勤能补拙！灵根天定，我们虽然决定不了，但却能磨炼自己的心性和毅力！你这炼气五层的灵力，比其他炼气七层的还要扎实精纯，果然是个好苗子！”
此话一出，全场哗然。那些嘲笑林越是四系伪灵根的人，尽都捂紧了嘴巴，连李长老都夸他了，谁还敢多嘴啊！
“继续吧！”李长老一脸赞许地看着林越。
content_en:
Qingyang City, Central Square!
There was a huge crowd of people, including the children of the major families in Qingyang City, all of whom were selected for the Qinglan Sect.
Qinglan Sect is a famous sect of cultivating immortals. If you can join the sect, you can reach the sky in one step and completely escape the shackles of a small town!
At this moment, the elders of the Lin family had already changed their faces. They were all surrounding Lin Yue with smiles and fawning words on their lips.
"Nephew Lin Yue, you will definitely come out on top in today's selection. The Lin family will all depend on you from now on!"
Even the clan leader Lin Yuanci personally presented a high-grade spiritual stone.
Lin Yue glanced at the spirit stone in his hand, but did not take it. He only said coldly: "It's a matter of duty."
Lin Yuanci retracted his hand nonchalantly, with an embarrassed smile on his face. Although he was angry in his heart, he did not dare to show it. After all, Lin Yue was already at the fifth level of Qi Refining, and he was still the talent that Elder Li favored. He was no longer the trash that everyone despised in the past and could be manipulated at will.
Not far away, several figures squeezed into the crowd. They were Lin Hao's father, Lin Kun, and Lin Hao, who was carried on a stretcher with one arm missing. The two father and son looked at me with great hatred, but they did not dare to take a step forward.
"The selection rules of the Qinglan Sect remain unchanged! First, the spiritual root qualifications are tested, and then the spiritual power level is tested. Finally, there is a voluntary competition, and the best among the best are selected. Those who pass the exam will enter the outer sect, and the top ones can compete for places in the inner sect!"
At this time, Elder Li, who was sitting on the high platform, spoke. As soon as he finished speaking, several disciples rushed forward to test their spiritual roots.
"The prince of the Wang family, Wang Teng, has three lines of miscellaneous spiritual roots and the fourth level of Qi refining!"
"Su Ming, a side branch of the Su family, has two spiritual roots and a third level of Qi refining!"
…
The crowd applauded. Elder Li stroked his beard and nodded in praise.
Soon it was Lin Yue's turn. As soon as he walked out of the crowd, the audience burst into laughter. Many people in the crowd pointed at him and laughed.
"Look, that loser from the Lin family is here too. He has four pseudo-spiritual roots. He's too embarrassed to show his face!"
"The Lin family is really in decline. Sending such a loser to participate in the selection is a waste of quota!"
"I heard that he is already at the fifth level of Qi refining. I think this is all their bragging. How can the pseudo-spiritual roots be cultivated so fast!"
"Lin Yue! You're a waste with fake spiritual roots. So what if you practice quickly? If your spiritual roots are not good, don't think about getting ahead. Get out of here quickly and don't waste everyone's time! I'm in a hurry to go home and eat instant noodles!"
Lin Yue turned a deaf ear and pressed his palm on the spirit-detecting jade.
Four dim lights lit up, which were the four pseudo-spiritual roots.
Boom——
The whole audience burst into harsh laughter again.
"Hahaha! It's really a fake spiritual root!"
"I'm just saying, no matter how high your realm is, it's still trash. Your spiritual roots are innate and cannot be changed!"
Lin Kun showed a sneer. The fourth-line pseudo-spiritual root was not even qualified to do odd jobs for the Qinglan Sect. Unless Elder Li was crazy, he would never choose such a loser.
Unexpectedly, at this moment, Elder Li suddenly stood up, walked quickly to the spiritual jade, stared at the four spiritual lights, and said in disbelief:
"Yes, it is true that you have pseudo-spiritual roots of the fourth system. However, although your spiritual roots are mixed, your spiritual energy is extremely stable and there are faint signs of purification. This is because you have been nourishing it with pure spiritual power for many years! Ordinary monks cannot do this at all. You are..."
“Diligence can make up for weakness. As long as you work hard enough, an iron pestle can be ground into a needle! "Lin Yue deliberately concealed the matter of brushing the demon pill last night. He was reborn three times in Black Wind Ridge and refined dozens of first-level Black Wind Wolf Demon Pills. The spiritual power in his body is of course several times purer than that of ordinary people.
Hehe, Lin Yue was secretly amused. Rebirth can inherit the spiritual power of the previous life. This is simply a loophole.
"Good hard work can make up for weakness! Although we can’t decide the destiny of our spiritual roots, we can hone our character and perseverance! Your spiritual power at the fifth level of Qi refining is more solid and pure than other people at the seventh level of Qi refining. You are indeed a good seedling! "
As soon as these words came out, the whole place was in an uproar. Those who ridiculed Lin Yue for being a pseudo-spiritual root of the fourth line all shut their mouths. Even Elder Li praised him, who dared to talk more!"Go on!" Elder Li looked at Lin Yue with approval.
